# Astonishing Touch Home Health & Senior Services L.L.C.

> Personalized in-home support based in Creve Coeur, Missouri. Founder: Brittany Wadley. Founded in 2018.

## Official information
- Website: https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/
- Office: 10880 Baur Blvd., Suite 103, Creve Coeur, MO 63132
- Telephone: (314) 479-5673
- Published after-hours telephone: (314) 276-4607
- Email: info@astonishingtouchhealthcare.org
- Office hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday.

## Services
- [Respite care](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#respite-care): Support at home while a family caregiver takes a break.
- [Friendly companionship](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#companionship): Conversation, shared interests and meaningful company.
- [Personal care](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#personal-care): Respectful support with everyday personal routines.
- [Hygiene assistance](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#hygiene-assistance): Help with personal hygiene routines based on comfort and preferences.
- [Meal planning and preparation](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#meal-preparation): Help planning and preparing meals.
- [Light housekeeping](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#housekeeping): Practical support with everyday household tasks.
- [Laundry assistance](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#laundry): Help with laundry and folding.
- [Medication reminders](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#medication-reminders): Reminders for an existing medication routine; not prescribing, dose changes or medication administration.
- [Assistance running errands](https://www.astonishingtouchhealthcare.org/#errands): Support with everyday errands.

## Care inquiries
Contact a live employee for pricing, payment questions, staffing, coverage area and availability. Published service descriptions do not establish insurance acceptance or eligibility. A website inquiry is a request for contact, not a confirmed appointment. Care plans and specific tasks require confirmation with the team.

Ask Brittany is an AI virtual receptionist, not the human founder. Generated care scenes are illustrative. No clinical services, guaranteed outcomes or customer ratings are asserted by this file.
